| description = Spawned by giving a [[Breath of Gwan]] to [[a sleeping ogre]](Note: a sleeping ogre must con indifferently, use sneak from behind to turn in).

Trunt hits for only 176, but is immune to stuns, magic, Poison, fire, and cold and attacks fast. He also casts a short range 200 point AoE called Fist of Earth.  Having a good tank is key to this fight (with a good tank and a few DPS a single Cleric only needs a couple CHs and some heal over time spells for the whole fight).

Mob seems unusually high AC for Kunark. Most hit with a max str warrior using a 30/45 weapon, firefist and aura of battle was 81 (pre chardok damage bonus tables). My suggestion is use weapons that deliver most their dps through damage bonus.

He drops Trunt's head, which is magic, lore, no drop and weighs 20. Trunt has no faction.  Respawns every 3 hours.
